newsitem.title: USA: Travelers oper earnings rose in most units.
newsitem.headline: Travelers oper earnings rose in most units.

text.p: Travelers Group Inc said it experienced earnings growth across its business lines with the exception of its consumer finance unit in the second quarter.
Travelers said, however, it saw "tangible signs of improvement in the consumer finance business, where operating earnings fell 10 percent to $54.1 million from $60.1 million a year ago.

In Travelers' Smith Barney unit, operating earnings rose slightly to $232.4 million from $229.8 million a year ago. Total revenues net of interest expense edged up to $1.62 billion, with total expenses holding flat at $1.23 billion.

Fee-based revenues at Smith Barney rose 16 percent to a record $385.4 million but investment banking revenues fell 15 percent to $254.5 million due to a slower underwriting environment, the company said.

Travelers' other units posted double-digit operating earnings growth, with a 17 percent improvement at Life & Annuity to $104.9 million from $89.7 million and a 24 percent gain at Primerica to $82.0 million from $66.0 million.
The company's share of earnings at Travelers Property Casualty Corp rose 28 percent to $230.3 million from $180.4 million a year ago.

Operating earnings before minority interest at its commercial lines business rose 17 percent to $209.3 million from $178.3 million in 1996 and rose 57 percent at its personal lines business to $101.3 million from $64.7 million.
